item.description:
Highly designed and made for people with hearing disability .Suitable For Normal To Moderate, Maximum Power Output 124 dB SPL, Frequency Range 300-4000 Hz. ,Everyday hearing aid protect from water to avoid damage.Fitted with the proven hearing aid technology you expect from Britzgo covers all the essential customer requirements and delivers superb sound quality. - Omni Directionality, Feedback cancellation, Speech & Noise Management.

---------------👉Product Features👈-----------------

❖ 【 EASY TO USE DESIGN 】 : Change the volume with ease with this specially designed ear amplifier. We’ve purposely designed this unit to be very simple and easy to use but also extremely effective in helping you hear what is most important. There are no confusing parts, just a simple yet very effective hearing device.

❖ 【 SPECIFICATION 】 : Weights: Less Than 10gm, Design: Sleek Design, Operated: Easy to Operate Battery, Size(L/W): 43*11.4 (MM)

❖ 【 EASY USE AND COMFORTABLE FEATURE 】 : is a professional hearing aid manufacturer which have produced a variety of hearing amplifier hearing aid. Our hearing amplifiers designed by audiologist are easy, durable, and comfortable to wear in either of the ears.

❖ 【 LONG BATTERY LIFE AND DURABLE DESIGN 】 : Our hearing amplifier is designed with a long-lasting hearing amplifier. We’ve also carefully designed this device with durability in mind so it does not break easily.

❖ 【 EASY TO HIDE AND COMFORTABLE TO WEAR 】 : This hearing device is unmatched in comfort and style. It is designed to be stylish and easily blend in with your body. Our device is comfortable in either ear.

--------------✨Product Details✨--------------
1. Material: medical - grade TPE environmentally friendly materials
2. Weight: about 8g
3. Working Time After Being Fully Charged: about 35H
4. Charging Time: about 2H
5. Quantity：1pcs
6. Left Or Right: universal
7. Decibel: 65-90db

--------------- 🔹【Tips for buyers】🔹-----------------
 🔸Reasons for whistling/noise:
Because of the small size of the hearing aid, the microphone and the sound generator are close to each other, and the feedback phenomenon will occur to make a sharp sound. At present, most of the wireless hearing aids on the market cannot avoid this phenomenon.

 🔸Solution to whistling/noise:
1. It is easier to howl when the amplified sound is loud, so turn off the hearing aid before trying it on, put the hearing aid in your ear after reducing the volume, start the hearing aid, and then adjust the volume
2. When the ear canal is completely closed, there will be no howling. Before wearing, test the size of the earplug to ensure that the earplug and the ear canal are fully fitted without gaps.
3.After the hearing aid enters the ear canal, it is recommended to push the hearing aid with your fingers and hold it for 1-2 seconds, then release it to fully extend the earphone.
